end.summary:
Discussed objects that roll, slide, and stack.
Identified a ball and marble as rolling objects.
Explained that a bottle can slide and stack when it has a flat top.
Explored how a rubber can slide and stack on its flat side.
Lesson ended before teach-back was passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised sorting objects by whether they roll, slide, or stack. Anika used the ball and marble to explain rolling, and described how a bottle and rubber can slide or stack when placed on a flat side. Anika first needed help with the bottle, then corrected the idea during the lesson. At home, you can sort a few safe household objects together and ask, “Will it roll, slide, or stack?”
